subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this consent-bound, ownership-aware Claws removal lifecycle in core once the workspace-scoping defect and live package-proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The PR introduces a new experimental core command family and destructive ownership semantics across agents, files, plugins, skills, and persistent provenance while the governing RFC and prerequisite stack remain open.

options.title: Fix and sponsor the stack
options.body: Require workspace-correct skill ownership and live plugin/skill lifecycle proof, then approve the RFC direction and land the stack in dependency order.

options.title: Keep status, defer removal
options.body: Narrow this slice to read-only lifecycle visibility until destructive package ownership and uninstall policy have a separately approved contract.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Keep the implementation unmerged until maintainers settle whether grouped Claws belong in OpenClaw core at all.

recommendation.title: Fix and sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Require workspace-correct skill ownership and live plugin/skill lifecycle proof, then approve the RFC direction and land the stack in dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: They raised the governing removal-ownership requirement, are assigned to the PR, and have direct history in the reused skill lifecycle.
